review.brief: Review change RM28-manualcharge-add-date-range-reader (tier 2 of roadmap RM28), module manualcharge. Read the DIFF of commits 5926be8, 9c24707, 8450748, 2e4f7f5 - not the whole module. Validate: (1) Module boundary - manualcharge imports no other module; the only edits outside internal/manualcharge/ are the two leader-owned test-fake stubs (T6) in internal/battery/reader_test.go and internal/gateway/handlers/charges_test.go, which must be stubs only, not behaviour changes. (2) Doc-pack conventions - ai/go-conventions.md (pgtype confined to the DB boundary, never in public types or test assertions), ai/architecture.md (no cross-module DB access, port-only access), CLAUDE.md docs-track-change (AGENTS.md Public Interface block must match the real Reader interface verbatim). (3) Spec/tasks coverage - every requirement in specs/manual-charge-log/spec.md is implemented; every tasks.md item is genuinely done. (4) TEST-CONTRACT RULE (priority check): design.md authored the six-case test contract (a)-(f) BEFORE implementation. Verify each of the six tests asserts what the CONTRACT specifies, not what the implementation happens to return. A test weakened to match the code is a blocker finding. (5) Performance-Profile compliance and design fidelity - the change must add NO migration and NO index; design D3 claims idx_manual_charge_entries_vehicle_time (account_id, tesla_id, charged_on DESC) already covers the query. If any DB object was in fact added or altered, that is a BLOCKER (it bypassed the user's database design gate). Also confirm ORDER BY charged_on DESC and no LIMIT (D1/D2), and that the existing two Reader methods and the whole Writer port are untouched. (6) Anti-gaming - no task title, acceptance criterion, or assertion was weakened or deleted; tasks.md additions are append-only (T6 was appended by the leader, which is legitimate). TEST-EXECUTION-POLICY (verbatim): 'Claude writes tests but never runs the suite - never go test ./..., make test, make test-with-db or make check. It MAY run go build ./..., go vet ./..., gofmt -l, make build, make vet, make bins, and the standalone guards make ui-guard / make i18n-guard / make money-guard. The owner runs the suite and reports results; work that is complete but unexecuted is awaiting-user-verification, never done, and a passing suite is recorded as the owner's report, never claimed by the assistant.' SIGNAL PROVENANCE: go build ./..., go vet ./... (repo-wide), gofmt -l and openspec validate --strict were ASSISTANT-run and clean. The TEST SUITE was USER-run: the owner reported it green on 2026-08-16. You must judge test quality by READING the tests, never by running them.

decisions.decision: The new method orders charged_on DESC, not ASC for tier 3's convenience.
decisions.why: The covering index is already DESC, so ORDER BY is free and no sort node is added; tier 3 builds a keyed map and does not care about order. One ordering convention per module.

decisions.decision: database design gate NOT tripped: no migration, no new index.
decisions.why: idx_manual_charge_entries_vehicle_time (account_id, tesla_id, charged_on DESC) already serves the two equality predicates plus the charged_on range as one index scan. Verified in the migration before dispatch.

decisions.decision: Leader fixed the two out-of-module test fakes itself and appended T6, rather than dispatching battery and gateway workers.
decisions.why: Two stub methods are cross-module integration, which the leader owns; two dispatches with full doc-pack reads would cost far more than the edit.
